evidence.title: Climate Risk Integration in Credit Assessment
evidence.summary: The Group enhanced its climate risk assessment capabilities across commercial banking and retail lending in 2024. Key developments include transition risk assessments for commercial banking, EPC controls for buy-to-let lending, and physical inspections for flood-risk properties in mortgage origination.
evidence.quote: Key developments in 2024 for assessing climate-related credit risks include: • Transition risk assessments across Commercial Banking lending have been enhanced, including updating of the assessment criteria, incorporating methodology from our credible transition plan work, expanding into key net zero sectors: SME agriculture and commercial and residential real estate • Retail credit decisioning has EPC controls for new and existing lending for buy-to-let, and property specific transition costs considered as part of the residential affordability assessment • The mortgage origination stage requires a physical inspection for all properties exposed to increased flood and coastal erosion risk
